name: What steps are involved in the bathroom cabinet installation process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the bathroom cabinet installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The bathroom cabinet installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your space. Following design and selection, the existing cabinets (if any) are carefully removed, and the area is prepared. This might involve minor wall repairs or adjustments to ensure a level surface. New cabinets are then securely installed, leveled, and aligned, followed by the installation of countertops, sinks, and hardware. We coordinate all necessary steps, from initial demolition to final touches, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. You'll need to decide on your cabinet style and materials upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, removal of old cabinets, site preparation, new cabinet installation, and finishing touches with countertops and hardware.
